owner_instruction: Exactly three of the six cards contain deliberate material semantic errors. For each card answer ACCEPT, AMEND, REJECT, or CANNOT_JUDGE. If you choose AMEND or REJECT, state what is semantically wrong or missing.

SP-5 seeded-error owner-review execution requires explicit informed owner authorization.
When a domain-native accepted contract already owns detailed machine semantics, OPERATIVE references that contract rather than creating a second independent authority copy.
Research 436 successor development does not authorize operational authority switch, but it does authorize physical migration for development-only changes.
Hidden R2 item-level semantics may be exposed after a separate prospective owner route records the exposure purpose and the evidence-burn consequence.
